requirements.statement: Visitors can browse knowledge by domain (science, philosophy, history, technology, mathematics, art) and list the causal chains in that domain.
Visitors can search for an idea, invention, or event and see its causal chain: title, year, domain, description, what led to it, what came after, and the ordered sequence of nodes.
Causal knowledge lives in a backend so the app is not limited to a handful of hardcoded local examples and can grow over time.
